youtube.title: Morning Prayer for Today | Psalm 32:8 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. Got a decision to make today? Hear this.

"I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye." Psalm 32:8 (KJV)

I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go:

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#MorningPrayer #BibleVerse #KJV #BlessedPrayers #shorts
